name: DENEndSNOMEDConceptMap
title: DEN.End ConceptMap to SNOMED CT
description: Candidate mappings from DEN.End local answer concepts to SNOMED CT, transcribed from the source data dictionary without asserting exact equivalence.

text.div: Only targets supplied in the workbook are included. Candidate targets use relatedto pending terminology review; blank and not-classifiable cells have no target. The LOINC codes identify date-valued concepts, whereas the DEN.End answers are categorical closure reasons.

target.comment: Candidate transcribed from source row 4 (DEN.End); the workbook cell is displayed in scientific notation and is normalized here as 399307001. The target was not independently verified and is retained as relatedto pending review.
